swim.name: Swim
swim.synergyNotes: Traversing water surfaces and strong currents. Armor check penalty is doubled on Swim checks.

actions.name: Swim in Calm Water
actions.description: Swim at one-quarter speed as a move action or one-half speed as a full-round action.

actions.name: Swim in Rough Water or Rapids
actions.description: Navigate turbulent river rapids or choppy waves without being pulled under.
